about.en: MinoTari (XTM) is the native coin of the Tari base layer, a proof-of-work Layer 1 blockchain written in Rust by the Tari Project, with Mimblewimble-based confidential transactions and merge mining with Monero. XTM is the coin on Tari's own chain; Wrapped MinoTari (wXTM), the ERC-20 bridged to Ethereum, is a separate token.
